qti-item-body.p: A civics item asks the student to choose the strongest evidence for a local-news claim.

qti-choice-interaction.qti-prompt: A local newspaper reports that the library's weekend tutoring program improved attendance. Which detail would best support that claim?
qti-choice-interaction.qti-simple-choice: Attendance records show that average Saturday visits rose from 42 to 68 students after tutoring began.
The library repainted the study room in a brighter color during spring break.
Several tutors said they enjoyed helping younger students with homework.
The tutoring flyers used the same logo as the summer reading program.
The library closes one hour earlier on Sundays than it does on Saturdays.
